verdict: The single-flavon epsilon construction does not merely fail to hit specific values -- it removes almost ALL continuous freedom (18 real params -> 1), leaving far LESS than the 10 physical parameters needed per sector. It is not a fitting failure, it is a dimension-counting impossibility: the construction is overconstrained in exactly the wrong direction. Multi-flavon constructions (Z40 Cases A-C) were separately shown to overshoot back past 10, i.e. they re-import at least as much freedom as they were meant to explain, never landing near the physical target from first principles. No parameter regime tested here or in Z6-Z40 lands near 10 for a reason -- see z42_no_go_test.py.
